We wish to inform you that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, representatives of the Company shall participate in the meetings of group of investors as per schedule given in the enclosed intimation.
Varun Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Investors and Analysts Conference Call

Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, link of audio recording of Investors & Analysts Conference Call held on October 30, 2026 (post declaration of Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Nine Months ended September 30, 2026) is given in the enclosed intimation.
Varun Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 30, 2026, declared 3rd Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share.
Varun Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of 3rd Interim Dividend  is 05-Nov-2026.
Varun Beverages Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Unaudited Financial Results of the Company (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter and Nine Months ended September 30, 2026

Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company will host a conference call with Investors and Analysts on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 2:00 P.M. (IST). Details of the conference call with Investors and Analysts are enclosed

Investment and Borrowing Committee of the Board of Directors at its meeting held today approved to invest upto 26% of Equity Share Capital of Jager Renewables Private Limited (a special purpose vehicle inter-alia engaged to generate & supply solar power to consumers in the state of Uttar Pradesh) for a consideration of upto Rs. 4.10 Crore to obtain solar power for captive consumption as per details in enclosed intimation.
